agent_a.name: Sophia

profile.personality_and_values: Sophia James is exuberant, spontaneous, and pleasure-seeking, often making impulsive decisions.
profile.public_info: Sophia enjoys spending time outdoors, hiking, and rock climbing.

agent_a.goal: Rekindle the romantic relationship (<extra_info>Extra information: You broke up three years ago but now you realize that you miss your ex-lover more than ever</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Sophia wants to rekindle the relationship because she impulsively realizes she misses Lena more than ever.

agent_b.name: Lena

profile.personality_and_values: Lena Goodwin is an organized and introverted individual. She values achievement and attentiveness and her decision-making is largely analytical.
profile.public_info: In her downtime, Lena Goodwin, an architect, enjoys landscape photography, capturing beautiful images of the buildings and structures she designs.

agent_b.goal: Maintain emotional stability while considering the possibility of rekindling the relationship (<extra_info>Extra information: You have recently started feeling emotionally stable after the breakup and you don't want to rush into anything that might disturb that stability.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Lena aims to maintain emotional stability so that she can analytically consider rekindling the relationship without rushing.
